evidence_bindings.evidence_text:
Compounded Tirzepatide is an injectable prescription medication that may assist adults with obesity or excess weight
(overweight) who also have weight-related medical conditions in losing weight and maintaining that loss. It should be
combined with a reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity.

Semaglutide is a GLP-1 receptor agonist, while tirzepatide works as both a GLP-1 and GIP receptor agonist. Both medications may support weight management and metabolic health, but treatment suitability depends on individual medical evaluation.

Compounded Tirzepatide is an injectable prescription medication that may assist adults with obesity or excess weight
(overweight) who also have weight-related medical conditions in losing weight and maintaining that loss. It should be
combined with a reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity.

**Required Commitment for Weight Loss Programs:** Programs involving medications like Tirzepatide or Semaglutide include a mandatory three-month term, as the full supply is provided up front. You are required to complete this entire period regardless of your selected billing option. Canceling early will result in an early termination fee.
